prompt: Create an original 60 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 48 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A classical chamber piece featuring a string ensemble and harpsichord, evoking a melancholic and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首古典室内乐作品，以弦乐合奏和大键琴为主，营造出忧郁而沉思的氛围。
